_producer: src/4.llm_refine_papers.py (process_file -> save_json; data is mutated to add data['llm_ranked'] = sorted per-paper reviews)
_producer_notes: Output path is archive/${RUN_DATE}/rank/arxiv_papers_${RUN_DATE}.llm.json. Top-level JSON retains prior keys (papers / queries / global_* / reranked_at) and adds 'llm_ranked' (an array of per-paper review dicts with keys paper_id, score, reasoning, requirement_index, requirement_label, requirement_score, matched_tags, etc.) plus 'llm_ranked_at'. There is NO top-level 'papers[].llm_score' attribute — the per-paper score lives on the llm_ranked entry that maps back to paper_id. Schema checks the existence of the containers the producer actually writes.
